NOTE: Patch catalog for Zevro Morphe Patches.

patches.name: Linear lesson progress
patches.description: Removes the experiment curve so the lesson progress bar fills in proportion to completed steps.

patches.name: Constant speed lesson progress
patches.description: Animates lesson progress at a constant speed with no easing, overshoot or start delay.

patches.name: Disable Rive lesson progress bar
patches.description: Uses the Android lesson progress bar instead of the experimental Rive animation.

patches.name: Remove leagues
patches.description: Removes the Leagues tab, Diamond Tournament, related deep links and session-end screens.

patches.name: Block leagues notifications
patches.description: Stops Leagues, leaderboard, tournament and friend-nudge push notifications.

patches.name: Remove video calls
patches.description: Removes the video-call tab and its promotions from session-end, app-open, Practice Hub and Plus screens.

patches.name: Remove video call path nodes (experimental)
patches.description: Removes video-call levels from the learning path. Unit completion is untested; disabled by default.

patches.name: Hide video call quests
patches.description: Hides the daily quests that require a video call.
